authority.tenantAuthority: current ACTIVE membership resolved by the M2-T01 boundary
authority.permissionAuthority: central M2-T02 permission evaluator backed by the frozen tenant role matrix

pageAggregate.identity: A page identity is tenant/site scoped and distinct from every mutable draft and immutable published version.

slug.uniqueness: A slug may repeat in another tenant or site but never within one active tenant/site scope.

pageAggregate.archiveRule: Archive preserves immutable published/history/audit evidence and makes the page unavailable for new draft mutation until an explicitly accepted restore contract exists.
pageAggregate.draftConcurrency: Every draft mutation supplies expectedDraftVersion; a mismatch returns VERSION_CONFLICT without a lost write.

versioning.publishedVersion: An immutable snapshot with pageId, content digest, schemaVersion, themeVersion, SEO snapshot, actor, correlationId and publication receipt.
versioning.immutability: Published version payloads and receipt fields never mutate. Corrections create a new version.
versioning.rollback: Rollback validates a prior immutable version and creates a distinct new publication receipt/version; it never rewrites the old version or moves history in place.
versioning.preview: Preview is draft-bound, authorized and non-public. It never changes public resolution or crawler output.

rules: The server evaluates fresh tenant permission and the exact candidate draft version before every transition.
A rejection returns to DRAFT and requires a bounded human-readable reason.
A creator cannot self-approve or self-publish unless a later accepted role policy explicitly permits it.
Every transition has immutable safe actor, tenant, page, candidate version, action, result, trace and timestamp metadata.

idempotency.requestKey: An authenticated publish or rollback request carries one opaque Idempotency-Key scoped to organizationId, pageId and operation.
idempotency.sameRequest: A retried key with the same request fingerprint returns the original terminal receipt without creating another version or audit record.
idempotency.differentRequest: A reused key with a different fingerprint returns IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED and performs no transition.
idempotency.retention: Retention/expiry is a future persistence policy; no client may assume key reuse is safe after expiry.

publishing.durableTruth: Publication commit and immutable receipt are durable truth. Cache, search, realtime and outbox invalidation are downstream consumers and never the source of publish correctness.

seo.snapshot: Each publication freezes typed SEO metadata with the immutable published version.

fields.locale: BCP-47 language tag from an accepted allowlist
fields.canonical: Derived only from an accepted site canonical host/path policy; editor input cannot choose a foreign host or arbitrary URL.
fields.jsonLd: One allowlisted structured data type and bounded typed fields; arbitrary JSON, script, HTML and remote URLs are rejected.

seo.crawlerRule: Crawler output resolves only from the exact published tenant/site version. It never exposes a draft, private preview, unpublished metadata or another tenant's cache entry.

theme.reference: A publication references one immutable, validated theme version.
theme.fallback: If a referenced published theme is unavailable, public resolution uses the accepted safe fallback and records a safe degraded result; it never executes an editor-supplied style.

authorization.pageRead: organization.read plus a resolved current tenant context
authorization.draftWrite: page.create or page.update as appropriate plus a resolved current tenant context
authorization.workflowTransition: server-owned action-to-permission mapping evaluated freshly at execution
authorization.tenantBoundary: A request-supplied organization, page, site, version, slug, canonical host or idempotency key is never authorization proof.

limitations: This contract defines no migration, persistence, backend, UI, preview token issuer, cache, realtime, outbox, provider call or hosted behavior.
Page block schema and rendering are owned by M2-T04/M2-T05 and are referenced by schemaVersion only.
M2-T07 implements the publishing transaction; M2-T08 owns theme persistence; M2-T09 owns executable workflow transitions.
